title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard: export de-identified user-level Copilot metrics
summary: The briefing's licensing, default-on export, access controls and rollout dates are supported by Microsoft's sources. Minor corrections should complete the policy routes, distinguish weekly exports from daily exports, and remove checklist instructions that have no corresponding controls-table row.

claims.claim: The roadmap products are Microsoft Viva and Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365).
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Viva", "Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)"]

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.where: front matter: targetDate; summary; What's changing
claims.claim: General availability is targeted for November CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "November CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap preview target is October CY2026.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "October CY2026"

claims.where: front matter: clouds; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant).
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.where: front matter: platforms; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap lists the Web platform.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

claims.claim: The roadmap release phases are General Availability and Preview.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified on October 15, 2026.
The roadmap describes exporting row-level Copilot metrics from the dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.
claims.quote: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.

claims.claim: The Copilot Dashboard has an Export data option.
claims.quote: Eligible tenants and users can export directly from the Copilot Dashboard by selecting Export data.

claims.claim: The Copilot Dashboard is hosted in the Viva Insights web app.
claims.quote: If you have access to the Copilot Dashboard, you can find it in the Viva Insights web app. On the left, select Copilot Dashboard.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Company-level dashboard users can export user-level metrics.
claims.quote: Data export is available only to users with global access to the Copilot Dashboard.

claims.where: What's changing; Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: MC1173208 describes de-identified, row-level Copilot usage metrics.
claims.quote: Users will be able to export de-identified, row-level Copilot usage metrics from the dashboard.

claims.where: What's changing; Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: MC1173208 describes metrics aggregated by user and week.
claims.quote: This feature allows dashboard users with company-level access to download de-identified Copilot usage metrics, aggregated by user and week, from the past six months.

claims.claim: MC1173208 says the dataset spans the past six months.
claims.quote: The dataset includes weekly, user-level metrics from the past six months.

claims.claim: MC1173208 says usage covers apps such as Word, Excel and Teams.
claims.quote: The export supports Copilot usage analysis across apps (such as Word, Excel, Teams)

claims.where: What's changing; Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: MC1173208 names Organization and Job function as the two export attributes.
claims.quote: includes two attributes: Organization, and Job function.

claims.where: What's changing; Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: MC1173208 represents each user by a hashed ID.
claims.quote: The export output remains de-identified, with each user represented by a hashed ID.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Export is enabled by default for eligible users without admin setup.
claims.quote: The feature is enabled by default for eligible users. ... No admin setup is required to start using the export.

claims.where: What's changing; Security & identity; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Managers whose data access is limited to their own teams cannot export.
claims.quote: Managers or their delegates with team-level views don't have access.

claims.claim: The Learn export documentation is explicitly public preview.
claims.quote: This feature is for public preview customers only. Features in preview might not be complete and could undergo changes before becoming available in the broader release.

claims.claim: The preview supports a week-level export spanning six months.
claims.quote: You can download week-level metrics spanning the past six months

claims.claim: The preview supports a day-level export spanning 28 days.
claims.quote: or day-level metrics spanning the past 28 days.

claims.claim: Personal identifiers are replaced by anonymised IDs unless the administrator enables identifiable export.
claims.quote: Personal identifiers are removed and replaced with anonymized IDs, unless your administrator has enabled identifiable export for you.

claims.claim: MC1173208 gives public preview from early to late October 2026.
claims.quote: Public Preview: Begins in early October 2026 (previously early December 2025), completes by late October 2026 (previously late December 2025).

claims.claim: MC1173208 gives Worldwide GA from mid-November to the end of November 2026.
claims.quote: General Availability (Worldwide): Begins in mid-November 2026 (previously mid-October), completes by end of November 2026 (previously end of October).

claims.claim: MC1173208 has an end date of November 30, 2026.
claims.quote: Microsoft's end date 2026-11-30

claims.claim: MC1173208 sets no act-by date.
claims.quote: Act by: none

claims.claim: The dashboard normally presents aggregated metrics.
claims.quote: Metrics are aggregated at the tenant level or user level, depending on the licenses your tenant has.

claims.claim: The export downloads a file through the user's browser.
claims.quote: After you select Export data, the download starts automatically in your browser.

claims.claim: The preview allows personal data processing.
claims.quote: This preview feature allows personal data processing.

claims.claim: The export includes Copilot Chat usage by users without Copilot licences.
claims.quote: Track Copilot Chat adoption, including activity and usage from users without Copilot licenses.

claims.claim: Users cannot customise the exports or trim their metric selection.
claims.quote: You can't customize the exports.

claims.claim: Eligible company-level users include senior leaders automatically identified through Entra ID.
claims.quote: Senior leaders automatically identified through Entra ID data.

claims.claim: Users manually assigned global access by admins are eligible.
claims.quote: Users manually assigned global access by admins

claims.claim: Delegates assigned by users with global access are eligible.
claims.quote: Delegates assigned by users with global access.

claims.claim: Viva Insights Analysts with global access are eligible.
claims.quote: Viva Insights Analysts with global access

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Global Administrators with company-level access are eligible.
claims.quote: Access requirement – You must have global access to the Copilot Dashboard. This includes: ... Microsoft 365 Global Administrators

claims.claim: Delegates of global-access users inherit export access unless an admin policy disables it.
claims.quote: Yes. Delegates of users with global access automatically inherit data export access, unless your organization's admin policy disables it.

claims.claim: A person selects Export data and then Export by week or Export by day.
claims.quote: Select Export by week, to download the last six months of data; or select Export by day, to download the last 28 days of data.

claims.claim: MC1173208 calls the VFAM feature Copilot Metrics Export in the Viva Insights module.
claims.quote: Admins can manage access via Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) settings, under Module: Viva Insights; Feature: Copilot Metrics Export.

claims.claim: Learn now names the setting User-level export and insights.
claims.quote: The Export setting that previously controlled access to the export feature is now called User-level export and insights

claims.claim: The export setting also governs user-level insights on specific application cards.
claims.quote: This setting now controls access to the following: ... User-level insights on specific cards in the application

claims.claim: The export setting also governs user-level insights from Interactive insights.
claims.quote: User-level insights from Interactive insights

claims.claim: Export policy changes can take up to 24 hours to appear.
claims.quote: Changes can take up to 24 hours to appear in the web app.

claims.claim: The export includes only completed weeks while the dashboard includes partial weeks.
claims.quote: The export only includes data for completed weeks, while the dashboard includes partial week(s) along with completed weeks.
claims.fix: Change the sentence to 'Expect questions about mismatched numbers: the week-level export includes only completed weeks, while the dashboard includes partial weeks.' The same page separately documents day-level exports.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The export is an included capability of qualifying Copilot or Viva Insights licensing.
claims.quote: License requirement – Your tenant must have at least 50 Copilot or Viva Insights licenses assigned.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn lists at least 50 assigned Copilot or Viva Insights licences as the tenant prerequisite.
claims.quote: Your tenant must have at least 50 Copilot or Viva Insights licenses assigned.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: MC1173208 instead requires at least 50 Microsoft 365 Copilot licences.
claims.quote: This feature requires at least 50 Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses and applies to the Viva Insights web app.

claims.claim: The dashboard is available to business or enterprise Microsoft 365 or Office 365 customers with an active Exchange Online account.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Copilot Dashboard in Viva Insights is available to any customer with a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 subscription for business or enterprise, and who has an active Exchange Online account.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft publishes no separate export licence, add-on or price in the sources checked.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot Dashboard export metrics pricing separate license meter export audit event exclusion list'; '"Copilot Dashboard" "export" "price" "license"'. Read export-copilot-metrics and copilot-dashboard on Learn and MC1173208; no separate export licence or price stated.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter and cap; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The export page documents no export meter, credit rate or spending control.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Copilot Dashboard export metrics pricing separate license meter export audit event exclusion list'; '"Copilot Dashboard" "export" "price" "license"'. Read Learn export-copilot-metrics in full and the dashboard licensing section; no export meter, rate or spend control found.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Indirect cost; Governance guidance
claims.claim: MC1173208 recommends reviewing company-wide dashboard access assignments.
claims.quote: Review the assignment of the Copilot dashboard users with full company-wide data access and adjust VFAM policies as needed.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Indirect cost; Governance guidance
claims.claim: MC1173208 recommends communicating the upcoming feature to eligible users.
claims.quote: Communicate the upcoming feature to eligible users so they know what to expect.

claims.claim: Copilot Analytics processing takes up to seven days after licence assignment, with an exception for day-level exports.
claims.quote: Data processing in Copilot Analytics takes up to seven days following license assignment, unless you're exporting day-level metrics, which provides more recent data.

claims.claim: Organization is determined through Entra ID or an admin-uploaded organisational data file.
claims.quote: Organization | Determined by Entra ID or through an organizational data file uploaded by admins.

claims.claim: Job function is blank in the export if the uploaded organisational file lacks the field.
claims.quote: FunctionType (Job function) | Determined by the organizational data file uploaded by admins. If the file doesn't include this field, the column appears blank in the export.

claims.claim: The export policy route is Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Access setting, with app and feature selection specified in the note.
claims.quote: Select Create a policy. ... Name the policy and select the app and feature for which you'd like to set the policy. ... Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off
claims.fix: Include the selection already described in the note: 'Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Viva Insights > Copilot Metrics Export > Access setting'. Keep the qualification that Learn calls the setting User-level export and insights. See https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/control-access-admin-center.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId <FeatureId from Get-VivaModuleFeature> -Name <policy name> -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a tenant-wide disabled export policy.
claims.quote: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId Reflection -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone ... The FeatureId value is returned in the output of the cmdlet.

claims.claim: The web-app policy route is Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Access setting, with the feature selection specified in the note.
claims.quote: Select Create a policy. ... Name the policy and select the app and feature for which you'd like to set the policy. ... Select the Access setting option and choose On or Off
claims.fix: Include the selection already described in the note: 'Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > Viva Insights > Viva Insights web app > Access setting'. See https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/control-access-admin-center.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone disables the web app for the tenant.
claims.quote: Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant ... ModuleId : VivaInsights ... FeatureId : Viva Insights web app ... Name : DisableFeatureForAll ... IsFeatureEnabled : false ... Everyone

claims.claim: The feature-access table identifies Global admin as the export control's administrator.
claims.quote: Copilot Metrics Export (Preview) | No | Global admin | Viva Insights

claims.claim: Disabling the Viva Insights web app disables the whole app, including the Copilot Dashboard.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.claim: The settings page identifies AI Administrator as able to manage the web-app control.
claims.quote: Enable or disable the Viva Insights web app ... Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights retrieves the feature identifiers.
claims.quote: Get-VivaModuleFeature -ModuleId VivaInsights ... Find the feature that you'd like to create an access policy for and make note of its featureID.

claims.claim: User or group policies override tenant-wide policies, so a custom policy can allow access despite tenant-wide Off.
claims.quote: Custom policies take precedence over your org-wide settings. For example, if you have organization-wide access turned off, a custom policy could still allow access for specific users or groups.

claims.claim: The export control does not support user opt-out.
claims.quote: App | Feature | Control for user opt-out? | Who can manage access ... Copilot Metrics Export (Preview) | No | Global admin

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy requires Global Administrator membership or a role assigned at the feature level.
claims.quote: Currently, you need to be a member of the Global Administrators role or the roles that have been assigned at the feature level to run this cmdlet.

claims.claim: One unified setting controls weekly and daily export.
claims.quote: The VFAM control is a single unified control for both the week-level and day-level export options.

claims.claim: AutoCxoIdentification governs automatic dashboard access.
claims.quote: This feature access control allows AI Administrators to enable or disable the auto-enablement feature for the Viva Insights web app in their tenant. ... FeatureId : AutoCxoIdentification

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to inventory company-level dashboard access, but the controls table has no corresponding row.
claims.quote: List who holds company-level Copilot Dashboard access ... The controls table contains export policies and the Viva Insights web app control.
claims.fix: Remove the Before rollout bullet beginning 'List who holds company-level Copilot Dashboard access'. The access-assignment inventory has no corresponding control row; do not add a row in this correction.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to check access audit activities and VFAM change logs, but neither has a controls-table row.
claims.quote: Review changes to dashboard access in the audit log ... Check the VFAM change logs in Microsoft Purview ... The controls table contains only export and web app policies.
claims.fix: Remove the After rollout bullets beginning 'Review changes to dashboard access in the audit log' and 'Check the VFAM change logs in Microsoft Purview'. Neither has a corresponding control row; do not add rows in this correction.

claims.claim: The user-level export setting remains always on for analysts and cannot be changed for that role.
claims.quote: Since analysts already have access to user-level data through advanced analysis experiences, the above-mentioned setting is always on for the analyst role and can't be changed.

claims.claim: The auto-enablement control supports tenant policies only, not user or group policies.
claims.quote: This control supports tenant-level policies only, not user or group-level policies.

claims.claim: Modified CXO Settings logs assignment or removal of users and groups for Copilot Dashboard access.
claims.quote: Modified CXO Settings | ModifiedCXOSettings | This event logs the assignment or removal of users/groups to access the Microsoft 365 Copilot Dashboard.

claims.claim: Viva Insights audit activities include adding dashboard delegates.
claims.quote: Added delegate access | AddDelegates | A user added delegate access for organization insights or Copilot dashboard.

claims.claim: Viva Insights audit activities include removing dashboard delegates.
claims.quote: Removed delegate access | RemoveDelegates | A user removed delegate access for organization insights or Copilot dashboard.

claims.claim: VFAM change logs in Microsoft Purview provide history of policy creation, updates and deletion.
claims.quote: For a history of policy creation, updates, and deletions, see the Viva Feature Access Management (VFAM) change logs for your organization in Microsoft Purview.

claims.claim: The Viva Insights audit activities table names no event specifically recording dashboard metrics exports.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Copilot metrics" "export" "audit"'; searched audit-log-activities for Viva Insights, CXO, delegate and export, and read the complete Viva Insights table. DownloadedReport is a query-result download, not a documented dashboard-export event.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: MC1173208 does not describe day-level or identifiable export options.
claims.quote: The export output remains de-identified, with each user represented by a hashed ID. ... The dataset includes weekly, user-level metrics from the past six months.

claims.claim: The unified exclusion list hides specified users from aggregated dashboard insights.
claims.quote: Your organization might want to exclude certain users from being included in the aggregated insights in the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard

claims.claim: MC1173208 says admins can disable export at tenant or group level using VFAM.
claims.quote: Admins can disable the feature at the tenant or group level at any time using VFAM settings.

claims.claim: The documented export workflow describes a person initiating a download, not autonomous activity.
claims.quote: Eligible tenants and users can export directly from the Copilot Dashboard by selecting Export data. ... Select Export by week ... or select Export by day ... the download starts automatically in your browser.

claims.claim: Get-VivaModuleFeature reports supported policy scopes for each feature.
claims.quote: Some features only support policies that apply to the entire tenant, not specific users or groups. You can refer to supported policy scopes for a feature using the Get-VivaModuleFeature cmdlet.
